snippet.title: Cosminers - Official "Join the team" Teaser
snippet.description:
Join the Cosminers team and explore Tau Ceti F 🪐
https://discord.gg/SqxGKqYbbG

Discover new underground biomes and unexpected events on the surface. Mine, explore, fight!

Cosminers is a cooperative FPP game for 1–4 players 🛠️, based on building, mining, and survival in a day–night cycle. Mine, fight aliens 👾, and upgrade your equipment in procedurally generated underground areas to enjoy endless exciting gameplay.
